notes:
No primary table URL or parent-supplied paper text was provided. Existing terminal acquisition misses were checked for each DOI: texts/e914bbe5b4856abc163a8dd9.miss (original) and texts/89fb5da690cde464797f0599.miss (replication). They document publisher HTTP 403, no OA location from Unpaywall/OpenAlex, no Europe PMC result, and unsuccessful full-text alternatives; these were not repeated. Independent exact-title searches confirmed matching publisher records but yielded only abstract/section snippets, not full primary sources or the requested tables. No statistics or author verdict could be verified for the specific Dutch-sample discipline/new-product-introduction test. Replication bibliographic discrepancy: the supplied reference says 2005; publisher record identifies volume 24(6), December 2006, pages 932–947. No unavailable original statistics were filled from secondary sources.
Source follow-up: Published article copy: online 2005; Journal of Operations Management 24 (2006), 932–947. Table 7 numerics visually verified on rendered primary PDF p. 9. Target mismatch is substantive: no Dutch-only analysis or outcome named new product introduction in Table 7. The closest pooled-country TTM Step 2 statistics are explicitly labelled as such; they do not verify a Dutch target. Step 2 is the direct-discipline model before moderator terms. The printed Step 2 R2 (.037) is the full model variance explained; no R2 increment was computed. Step 3 R2 is .048, with discipline coefficient .237*; its p < .05 is a different test and is not assigned to Step 2. Authors report support for Hypothesis 2 across CUSTOM, VOLFLEX and MIXFLEX; no Dutch-specific verdict can be extracted.
Source follow-up: Published Collins, Cordon and Julien (1998) article, pp. 133–146. Table IV numerics visually verified on rendered primary PDF p. 14. R2 is for the new-product-introduction regression, not a separate coefficient for one discipline factor. The table prints strategic-process coefficient 0.395 with p = 0.0218 and quality-management coefficient 0.351 with p = 0.0768; neither coefficient-specific p is assigned to the model R2. Final-sample country pie chart (PDF p. 5) is graphical; Netherlands 10% is absent from canonical text and was visually checked, not converted to n. Text explicitly states 48 companies.
